salary.china_ai_row: Wind power O&M in China is rapidly digitizing. Centralized monitoring, drone blade inspections, and vibration-based predictive maintenance have been deployed at scale. Leading manufacturers are advancing low-staffing operations, increasing demand for technicians who can interpret data and troubleshoot faults.
salary.china_class_row: Primary employers in China: O&M service departments of turbine manufacturers such as Goldwind, Envision, and Mingyang; wind farm owners' O&M companies; third-party maintenance firms; and specialized offshore wind teams.

china_edu_table.岗位方向: Wind turbine repair technician, O&M technician

china_industry_table.需求: Strong maintenance demand from the installed fleet
High allowances and scarce talent
Factory commissioning and warranty maintenance
Blade repair and major-component replacement

salary.china_intl: Europe and the United States installed wind power earlier, and their turbine fleets are aging quickly, sustaining demand for O&M talent. Offshore wind is expanding rapidly in China, while overseas projects in Southeast Asia and the Middle East are also hiring. Technicians with foreign-language skills and knowledge of international safety standards have more opportunities.
